catalog_scope: all discovered trained endpoints, validation-best and saved budget endpoints; exclude initialization, engineering fixtures and intermediate recovery-only snapshots; auxiliary weights remain explicit table rows
evaluation_scope: every prepared dataset column for every standalone router; all supported pin counts, no retraining or test-based selection
decode: deterministic greedy; model.eval; no test-time adaptation
primary_metric: mean wirelength on the identical frozen coordinates within each column; lower is better
secondary_metrics: mean and P95 original task objective
mean and P95 percent regret where precision_v2 references exist
cross_degree: reuse identical weights and set decoder degree to the input pin count; explicitly label cross-degree results
rooted_tasks: pin 0 is a convention, not verified real-chip driver metadata
data_roles: keep historical test, validation, calibration, real-chip A/B/C, persisted training and fixed candidate pools distinguishable; do not claim all columns are unseen
resume: atomic 8192-net prediction shards and cursor; model lock; completed degree/model markers; restart same tmux launch command
